note: Real GT7 data captured by the driver, one car at a time, from the in-game tuning screen. UAT 2026-08-07 defect A7. This file is the ONLY source of truth about a car's actual slider limits, step sizes and stock values; everything else in the setup pipeline is a class archetype standing in until an entry lands here. Partial entries are supported and expected: a car with only 'stock' filled in still improves the anchor, and every field not captured falls back to the archetype for that car's class and is reported as ARCHETYPE tier so the Garage can say so. Keys are exact-case car names matching data/car_specs.json (matched tolerantly on chassis code, case and whitespace, as strategy.setup_ranges already does). Per-field shape: {"min": N, "max": N, "step": N} — any of the three may be omitted. Per-car shape adds optional "num_gears", "redline_rpm" and a "stock" map of field -> value. Written by the Garage's car-data capture panel; safe to hand-edit.
